Close to Jokowi
The two characters are equally accounted for close to Jokowi. Many times Jokowi has publicly given political support to Ganjar and Prabowo.

It makes a number of survey agencies study it. Indonesian political inspector in survey June 2023 called Ganjar to call it a will of capres supported by Jokowi at 45.2 percent. And then there's Prabowo with 29.8 percent, whereas Anies Baswedan is 9.6 percent.
"Ganjar is valued most supported by Jokowi, new Prabowo, and Anies," said the Executive Director of Indonesian Politics Indicator Burhanudin Muhtau in a written statement, Sunday (23 / 7).
